decisions.decision:
Build T-236 end to end against vendor-sim. Do not touch any real Tantra workspace.
1) Write one shared append helper (it can live in cloud/src/jobs-tantra.ts or a shared module) that calls POST /email-campaigns/:id/contacts with customFields for the join link and event time. T-234 and T-217 will reuse it.
2) In cloud/funnel/worker.js, sendEmailsTantra should call that helper when each reminder is due. Before each call, claim a row per attendee, day and reminder so a retry never sends twice.
3) jobs-tantra.ts creates one single-step omni-channel campaign per reminder moment, with the sending window open every day and hour. Add a WhatsApp step only when WhatsApp is connected.
4) Remove TANTRA_NOTE, TANTRA_WAIT, the 'not built' results, the /emails/batch sim route, tantra-send-contract.mjs and the 'Tantra must ship' wording. Mark tantra-reminder-endpoint.md superseded. Update probe-email-stripe and add the campaign checks.
5) Check every done_when item. Commit, push the branch and post a READY line in LOG.md. Then hand off to T-246.
decisions.why: google-and-reminder-model (2026-10-07) says Tantra campaign import is live and /emails/batch was our own invention. integrations-tantra-api.md section 5 (PR #142) gives the endpoint. Every done_when item can be tested on vendor-sim, so nothing needs Adi. The Tantra developer request (7c7d4bae) is withdrawn.
